description:
Create or update a text-based knowledge entry. Use this to store free-form text (notes, prompts, ICP descriptions, etc.) that can be retrieved by key.
Returns: { key, upserted, created }.

Requires write access when connected with OAuth.

key.description: Unique key for the text entry (e.g. "icp_description", "outreach_template").

tags.description: Optional tags stored in metadata for organisation.

title.description: Optional human-readable title stored in metadata.

name: upsert_knowledge_text
